name: Contango / Backwardation Sign Structure
description: For the cost-of-carry forward F(T) = S*e^{(r-delta)T}: contango F>S iff r>delta, backwardation F<S iff r<delta, and basis convergence F(0)=S.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Futures.Contango

open MathFin

/-- Contango/backwardation sign structure + basis convergence for the
    cost-of-carry forward F(T) = S*exp((r-delta)T). -/
theorem mf_futures_contango {S r delta T : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (S < S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * T) ↔ delta < r) ∧
    (S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * T) < S ↔ r < delta) ∧
    S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * 0) = S :=
  MathFin.contango_backwardation_basis hS hT
